items.text: A duplicate live delta with the same deduplication key is not re-injected. An assumption_invalidated message with matching plan/State Fence and evidence handle is durably admitted and reaches an EventIntegrated recipient only at its next safe model/tool boundary, without interrupting the current step. A plan-revision mismatch or unavailable delivery capability retains a visible rejected/degraded admission/delivery record and does not report recipient acknowledgement or awareness.
